description: Review fixes: Messages participant check, unread DM query restructuring, Firebase init hard failure, push_tokens rule, call_signals participant scoping
steps: 1. Fix messages Firestore rule: Add participants array check using resource.data.participants to scope reads to conversation participants only.
2. Fix unread DM query in AppShell.tsx: Replace dynamic field name `unread_${uid}` with a separate unread_counts collection query keyed by user uid.
3. Fix Firebase init: Replace console.warn with a throw to fail hard when required env vars are missing.
4. Add push_tokens Firestore rule: Add rule allowing authenticated users to read/write their own push_tokens subcollection.
5. Fix call_signals rule: Scope reads to from_user or to_user matching request.auth.uid.
acceptance_criteria: Messages rule checks resource.data.participants for read access
AppShell unread DM query does not use dynamic field names
Firebase init throws an error when required env vars are missing
push_tokens collection has a Firestore security rule
call_signals reads are scoped to participants only
findings: All 5 review issues addressed. Messages and call_signals rules now enforce participant-level access control. Firebase init throws a clear error with all missing var names when env vars are absent. push_tokens and unread_counts collections have proper Firestore rules. The unread DM query uses a dedicated unread_counts collection instead of dynamic field names. Build and tests pass.
